answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the trellis of free entry disappears, the sonnet of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the juniper case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops being.
